mapper.insert: INSERT INTO uphoto_detail (uphoto_id, uid, uphoto_like, uphoto_comment, uphoto_comment_detail, created_at) VALUES (#{upthotoId}, #{uid}, #{uphotoLike}, #{uphotoComment}, #{uphotoCommentDetail}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE uphoto_like = #{uphotoLike}, uphoto_comment = #{uphotoComment}, uphoto_comment_detail = #{uphotoCommentDetail}, created_at = IF(VALUES(uphoto_comment) = 1, VALUES(created_at), created_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE uphoto_detail SET uphoto_like = #{uphotoLike}, uphoto_comment = #{uphotoComment}, uphoto_comment_detail = #{uphotoCommentDetail}, created_at = IF(#{uphotoComment} = 1, #{createdAt}, created_at) WHERE uphoto_id = #{upthotoId} AND uid = #{uid}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_id = #{upthotoId} AND uid = #{uid}
SELECT * FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_id = #{upthotoId} AND uphoto_comment = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_comment = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT * FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_comment = 1 AND uphoto_comment_detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_comment = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_comment = 1 AND uphoto_comment_detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uphoto_detail WHERE uphoto_id = #{upthotoId} AND uphoto_like = 1
